title: Zirat Privacy
subtitle: Legal Terms
description: Our Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, how it may be shared, and your privacy rights when using our Services.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.text: We collect information you provide directly, such as account details, farm data, and payment information. We also collect usage data automatically, including device information, location data, and interaction logs.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
list: Provide, maintain, and improve our Services
Deliver personalized insights, alerts, and recommendations
Analyze usage trends and agricultural productivity
Communicate updates, support messages, and marketing materials
Prevent fraud, abuse, and security breaches
Comply with legal obligations and enforce our terms

sections.heading: Sharing & Disclosure
sections.text: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with:
list: Service providers assisting us with analytics, hosting, and support
Legal authorities if required by law or to protect our rights
Business partners for legitimate business purposes with consent

sections.heading: Cookies & Tracking
sections.text: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, remember preferences, and analyze traffic. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

sections.heading: User Rights
list: Access and correct your personal information
Restrict or object to certain processing activities

sections.heading: Data Storage and Security
sections.text: We implement encryption, secure servers, and access controls to protect your data. However, no online system is completely secure. Always safeguard your login information and use strong passwords.

sections.heading: International Transfers
sections.text: If you access our Services from outside India, your data may be transferred to and processed in countries with different data protection laws.

sections.heading: Updates to This Privacy Policy
sections.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted with a new “Last Updated” date. Continued use of our Services constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

footer.note: Thank you for trusting Zirat with your farm data!
